Thank you for registering for summer sailing camp at the CYC Community Sailing Center! We’re excited to have them join us on the water for a fun and educational experience.

  • Time: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM (except for Teen Adventure, which includes an overnight trip on Wednesday)
  • Location: Corinthian Yacht Club, Shilshole Bay Marina

As we get closer to the start of camp, we’ll send you a detailed email with everything you need to know, including a packing list, drop-off and pick-up instructions, and other important information. In the meantime, you can review our Frequently Asked Questions for details on what to bring, safety policies, and more.

If you are interested in learning how to sail as well, please check out our Adult Learn-to-Sail classes on our Adult Sailing Classes page. We'd love to have you out on the water with us!

Lastly, if you have any questions before then, feel free to reach out to us at info@cyccommunitysailing.org or call us at (206) 402-6870.

We can’t wait to see your child on the water this summer!

Kind regards,
Jack

--

Jack Killalea
Sailing Director
CYC Community Sailing Center
